name: dogfood-llm-ops-registry-app
description: Dogfood app v1.40-4 — a model registry + version rollout + A/B testing + canary promotion + shadow comparison service that drives @kiwa-test/ai-llm v0.5 llm-ops axis (registry updates + rollout advancement + A/B variant scoring + canary error-rate gating + shadow-vs-production delta) backed by both KIWA_MODE=real (Vercel AI SDK + Anthropic Messages API when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY + KIWA_LLM_BUDGET_USD are set) and KIWA_MODE=mock (in-memory registry + deterministic rollout percentages + variant scoring + canary threshold check + shadow delta) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-test/quality-metrics 11-axis release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-test/ai-llm -F @kiwa-test/core -F @kiwa-test/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
